name: What are soft close drawer slides and how do they work?

mainEntity.name: What are soft close drawer slides and how do they work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Soft close drawer slides are hardware mechanisms designed to prevent drawers from slamming shut. They incorporate a damping system, typically a hydraulic or air-filled cylinder, that engages as the drawer approaches its closed position. This system gently decelerates the drawer, ensuring a quiet and controlled closure. This feature protects drawer contents, reduces noise, and extends the lifespan of the cabinetry.
